readability.review: Final source readability and ownership audit
readability.status: pass; no unresolved source readability/layout findings
readability.method: Structural review of every global entry plus manual review of distinct window/global/C512/frontend/sampling/repack flows, shared helper call sites, variable-role consumers and numerical constant definitions. This is not a compiled or numerical equivalence proof.

scope.source_manifest_recipe: SHA256 of sorted csrc source relative paths, a space, SHA256(file bytes), and newline for each .cu/.cuh/.cpp/.h/.inl file.

checks.no_MultiplyAccumulate: MMA is the shared fragment interface
checks.narrow_storage_prefixes: Mixed descriptors and control metadata are plain; actual tensor/fragment payload and selectors use r_; shared/global address and layout roles use s_/g_. No invented logical-shared swizzle role was added.

shared_helper_review.accepted: Substantial reused arithmetic/layout primitives, real profile/storage types and ISA wrappers. Precision-pair reuse is real reuse. No external whole-kernel owner remains.
shared_helper_review.low_direct_count_explanation: ISA wrappers may have one direct wrapper caller; normalization/filter/activation math is reused transitively. PublishWindowDownsample and ClearDownsamplePadding have two actual frontend precision callers; window downsample globals contain their own publication and clear loops.

constants_review.result: Nontrivial recovered activation/exponent/epsilon/hash/color constants have CONST_* names. Exact bit patterns and observed arithmetic roles are documented; unknown original fitting rationale is not invented. Ordinary extents, bit masks and loop bounds remain visible.

resolved_findings.resolution: Removed exactly three empty scopes from constexpr specialization; no operations removed.
Renamed all18 SourceLane occurrences to r_SourceLane, matching their exclusive register-shuffle selector role.
Applied existing clang-format; non-comment/non-whitespace token equality verified.

qualification_limits: No compilation, GPU launch, timing, profiler run or commit performed in this review.
Source checks cannot establish native numerical equality or speed for the rebuilt binary.

window.scope: 40 window exports: 24 ordinary/view and 16 fused sampling entries
window.method: Copy original canonical bodies, select only explicit native-profile constexpr branches, bind parameters and inline physical IO/store bodies; preserve all selected arithmetic, intrinsics, pragmas and synchronization expressions.
verification: 40 unique files with exactly one unchanged exported signature each.
No RunWindow forwarding calls remain in generated entries.
Formatting preserves every non-comment/non-whitespace token of expanded source.
Selected constexpr branch decisions are retained per entry; no runtime condition is simplified.
No compilation or GPU execution performed by this subagent.
Root migrated all frontend users; obsolete RunWindow32 and FOrdinaryWindowIO removed after a complete source-reference check.
retained_shared_logic: Packed tensor MMA/linear/activation/normalization/attention/pooling primitives used by multiple entries.
Real register/shared fragment storage and record profile types.
temporary_frontend_dependencies: PublishWindowDownsample and ClearDownsamplePadding remain shared with frontend exports.
